title: Answer: complementarity, nonlocality and qubit counts in experience

statements.text: The theory is checked by looking for complementarity and Bell-type nonlocality in conscious experience, by memory-recall experiments that estimate the number of qubits involved, and by simulating a conscious process of about a dozen qubits.

sources.quote: In principle quantumness could be established through experimental demonstration of one of the two main nonclassical features of quantum theory: nonlocality and complementarity.
